<quote by="Proposed: Mel Bleak, Senator for Mournwold, Seconded: Ramos I Inigo I Raqueza, Senator for Kahraman">To commission a smugglers' cove in Tromsa
</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[smugglers cove]] in [[Tromsa]]
* Passed
* More information can be found in the '''[[Beneath a moonless sky]]''' wind of fortune

==Date==
* Summer 388YE

==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 14 wains of white granite
* 42 crowns in labour costs
* Three months to complete

==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Construct_Smugglers_Cove_in_Tromsa}}
==Outcome==
Once complete, the smugglers' cove will have the following effects:
* [[Fleet|Fleets]] from across the Empire will be able to take the '''Scout Smugglers Cove in Tromsa''' voyage
* [[Wintermark]] fleets will be able to take the '''Sail into the Cold''' voyage
